module: Career tutorial, in 9 steps (01enterVehicle to 09spmSignup). This module is a thin layer over gameplay_tutorial_runtime: it provides the step order, the step extension prefix (career_modules_tutorial_step<id>), the initial prefabs and the end action, and it saves progress in <profile>/career/tutorialState.json.
notes: At career start (onCareerActive), the tutorial only starts if career_career.tutorialEnabled is true.
At the end of the tutorial: autosave re-enabled, save, default career recovery, player state reset, raw POIs cleared and return to the "career" game state.
An invalid saved step is ignored (back to the first step).
The control functions return the runtime's boolean and resynchronize progress on success.
sharedTutorialData is captured at the end of module loading (copy of the runtime's reference).

sharedTutorialData.desc: Data shared between steps, from gameplay_tutorial_runtime.

isActive.desc: Indicates whether the tutorial is in progress.

getCurrentStep.desc: Returns the id of the current step.

getStepOrder.desc: Returns the ordered list of step ids.

getStepIdByIndex.desc: Returns the step id at a given index (starting from 1).

start.desc: Starts the tutorial via the runtime.

endTutorial.desc: Ends the tutorial (triggers the configured end action).

returns.desc: completedSteps from the runtime (empty if none).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Load hook: configures the runtime, reads tutorialState.json of the current profile and sends the progress to the runtime.

onSaveCurrentProfile.desc: Profile save hook: writes the progress to tutorialState.json.

onCareerActive.desc: Hook called when the career becomes active; starts the tutorial if enabled.

returns.desc: false if the tutorial is disabled.

onUpdate.desc: Update hook: relays to the runtime.

onPreRender.desc: Pre-render hook: relays to the runtime.

onGetRawPoiListForTutorial.desc: During the tutorial, adds the "garage" point (tutorial_apm_parking) to the POI list on the garageExteriorPark parking spot, with icon, name and big map thumbnail.
